Detail · one card from above, zoomed

annotations.text:
These are STATES OF ONE PAGE, not separate screens. The app stays a single scrolling page: the controls sit at the top, the item cards grow underneath them.

Same visual vocabulary as the live app - serif item names (matching in-game tooltips), rarity colours, mono mod text, 2-3px radii - translated to English and made denser.

New here: two-column card grid, a stats strip instead of a run-on sentence, and the cluster-jewel option picker.

Not a separate screen - this is one card from the results page, zoomed in so the interaction is readable.

It is live: toggle the enchants and flip Require to see the query change. This is the one mod that needs a choice instead of a threshold, and it is why those rows are still red in the shipped app.
